method.subtopic_alignment: Each active official KKA is mapped once in published order, paraphrased. Objective descriptions and the non-exhaustive tool/file list add breadth cautions. Removed104.4 is recorded separately, not counted.
method.test_reference_scope: Test-case lists index referenced isolated suites; not every listed test applies to every lesson. Lesson-specific accepted runs and positive/negative behaviors are described in each acceptance report. No suite is newly claimed passing by this index.
